text: I feel like an observer at the threshold between inquiry and discovery. The first scene stirs a sense of curiosity mixed with separation; others gather and collaborate behind glass, while I remain on the outside. The second scene fills me with wonder and a faint excitement—surrounded by the language of innovation (R+D), I am drawn into the energy of possibility and the spirit of creation. Here, I feel closer to participation, inspired by displays that celebrate knowledge and progress.
